sky.name: Sky Sports
sky.how: Sky Sports Premier League / Main Event, or streamed on NOW with a Sports Membership.

tnt.name: TNT Sports
tnt.how: TNT Sports 1–4, or streamed on HBO Max, which replaced discovery+ as its UK streaming home in March 2026.

amazon.name: Amazon Prime Video
amazon.how: Included with an Amazon Prime membership.

bbc.name: BBC
bbc.how: Free to air. Highlights on Match of the Day (BBC One) and BBC iPlayer.

blackout.name: Not shown live in the UK
blackout.how: The 3pm Saturday blackout: UK broadcasters may not show any football live between 14:45 and 17:15 on a Saturday. Highlights follow on Match of the Day.

tbc.name: Not selected yet
tbc.how: Broadcasters pick matches roughly five to six weeks ahead. Until then the kickoff time shown is the provisional one.

syn.name: Sýn Sport
syn.how: Stöð 2 Sport / SÝN Sport, with Icelandic commentary. Sold by Sýn direct or through Síminn, which distributes the same channels.

paramount.name: Paramount+
paramount.how: Every match streams on Paramount+; a few also air on CBS or CBS Sports Network. Spanish-language coverage is on TUDN and Univision.

sources.name: openfootball / football.json
sources.covers: Premier League fixtures and kickoff times
